mentions.name: Clojure web framework
mentions.description: A web framework written in Clojure designed to feel like Rails, Phoenix, or Next.js, with the goal of making Clojure web development more approachable and easier to sell to developers outside the existing Clojure community.
mentions.problem: Existing Clojure web frameworks are too focused on the Clojure community and are much harder to sell to developers who might otherwise use Clojure.
mentions.audience: Aimed at developers who might otherwise use Clojure, including those outside the existing Clojure community
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a web framework in Clojure.  There are already a few others, but they're, in my opinion, too focused on the Clojure community, and are much harder to sell to people I know who might otherwise use Clojure.  I wanted something that was more like a Rails or a Phoenix or a Next.js.
